_comment: Allowlist of yt-dlp options the Android app may accept from UNTRUSTED input (share intents, pasted links, deep links). Default deny. Reconciled on 15 Nov 2026 against the desktop host's real validator (muzammilAwan-dev/yt-downloader-pro, host/YTDLPHost/Services/CommandValidator.cs, MIT) which the hand-off package could not see: same three rules - only http(s) links as bare arguments, paths constrained to an allowed directory with an allowed extension, control characters/escaped quotes/unbalanced quotes/.. /UNC rejected. Still not shipped as code; Phase 1 implements the validator with tests. Options the APP sets for itself are listed separately in engine_internal_options and must never be accepted from an intent.

engine_internal_options._comment: Set by our own engine code only, never parsed from an intent. --load-info-json is deliberately in blocked_always for untrusted input (it makes yt-dlp read a local file) yet is the Phase 1 fix for the double extraction seen on the device, where download() re-resolved the URL and wasted ~18 s per item.

rules: Non-option arguments must be http(s) URLs.
Reject any option not in allowed_options (default deny).
--cookies must point to the app's own temp cookie file; delete it when the task ends.
--output / --paths must resolve inside the app-private download dir; publishing to MediaStore/SAF is done by the app, not by yt-dlp.
Incoming share intents and deep links are untrusted input.
